_comment: d1 #247 Friends of the Inn -- Selys's INN register. Attached ONLY to the selys_inn_guest entity; her guild hub (the delivery board, the 'over there' signpost) never rides along, so the context is off-duty-at-the-inn, not at-the-counter (the user's hard requirement). greet.speaker: Selys
greet.text: You actually work here? That explains the stew. The Guild canteen hasn't made anything worth queuing for in years.

offduty.speaker: Selys
offduty.text: Every day at the desk is long. Tonight it can wait. Nobody's asked me where anything is since I sat down, and I keep waiting for it anyway.

served.speaker: Selys
served.text: That's a proper bowl of stew. Barley in it and everything. Where does she even get barley before the pass opens?

options.text: "Couldn't tell you. I just carry the bowls."
